More than a year after the 2016 U.S. Presidential election, journalists are still making sense of the role of social class in the outcome.

In this week’s Working-Class Perspective, Jack Metzgar focuses on a recent Politico article that made waves to show how reporters often misdefine “the white working class,” leading many progressives to learn the wrong lessons from Trump’s election.
